t: That subsection (c) of section 302 of the Army and Air Force Vitalization and Retirement Equalization Act of 1948 is hereby amended by striking out the words “the enactment of this Act” and inserting in lieu thereof “July 1, 1949”.

fable.w: This section is a purely technical amendment that substitutes a date in an existing military retirement statute. There is no tempting reading here: it involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.
fable.s: is hereby amended by striking out the words “the enactment of this Act” and inserting in lieu thereof “July 1, 1949”
